description: Recommendations for a title, merged from AniList and Jikan (MAL), with scores and vote counts. AniList recommendations use community rating scores; Jikan adds MAL user recommendations with vote counts. Both sources are surfaced separately — not blended into a composite score.

id.description: AniList media ID of the title to get recommendations for.

liked_aspects.description: What you liked about this title — e.g. "the slow-burn romance" or "mecha action". Returned as-is in the response.

per_page.description: Recommendations per page from AniList. Maximum 25.

name: anime_get_recommendations

cap.description: The per-page limit applied. Present alongside truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: AniList has no media record for the requested source ID. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next_page.description: Whether more AniList recommendations are available.

liked_aspects.description: Liked aspects provided by the caller, or null.

notice.description: Next-page guidance. Present only when the recommendations page was capped.

recommendations.description: Merged recommendations, sorted by AniList rating descending. Items appear once even if both sources recommend them; sources array lists all contributors.

anilist_rating.description: AniList community recommendation rating. Higher = more recommended.

id.description: AniList media ID of the recommended title.

id_mal.description: MAL ID of the recommended title, or null.

jikan_votes.description: MAL user recommendation vote count, or null when not in Jikan results.

items.description: A source that includes this recommendation.

shown.description: Number of recommendations returned on this page. Present alongside truncated.

source_id.description: AniList ID of the source title.

source_id_mal.description: MAL ID of the source title, or null.

source_type.description: Source media type: ANIME or MANGA.

truncated.description: True when this page of recommendations was capped at per_page. Present only when the cap was hit.

title: Anime Get Recommendations
